title: SingleCoreParetoSupremacyContract
description: Strict contract defining single-core DEFLATE tier differentiation, chunk streaming, and Pareto evaluation models.

tier_id.description: Unique identifier for the compression tier

tier_name.description: Descriptive name of the compression profile

max_chain_depth.description: Maximum number of hash chain links traversed per candidate search

nice_match_len.description: Threshold match length that triggers immediate chain search termination

skip_intermediate_hashes.description: When true, skips per-byte hash insertion inside long matches

target_throughput_mbs.description: Minimum required throughput floor in MB/s

target_space_savings_pct.description: Expected space savings percentage on standard 100MB text corpora

chunk_size_bytes.description: Size of each processed slice in bytes

history_size_bytes.description: Active sliding window history size preceding current chunk

token_buffer_capacity.description: Maximum number of tokens in thread-local storage

is_final_chunk.description: True if the current chunk terminates the stream

bytes_processed.description: Total uncompressed input bytes processed across all chunks

bytes_written.description: Total compressed bytes emitted to the output buffer

ttzip_tier3_throughput_mbs.description: Physical single-core throughput of TTZip Tier 3 in MB/s

ttzip_tier3_savings_pct.description: Space savings percentage of TTZip Tier 3

ttzip_tier4_throughput_mbs.description: Physical single-core throughput of TTZip Tier 4 in MB/s

ttzip_tier4_savings_pct.description: Space savings percentage of TTZip Tier 4

libdeflate_l3_throughput_mbs.description: Competitor baseline throughput for libdeflate Level 3

libdeflate_l6_throughput_mbs.description: Competitor baseline throughput for libdeflate Level 6

is_pareto_strictly_dominant.description: True if TTZip points form a strictly upper-right bounding Pareto envelope
